text.text_html: Rosemary infused in natural coconut and olive oil. Massage a few drops into your scalp each day to nourish the roots, calm dryness and flakes, and help reduce breakage so hair looks thicker and fuller.

tab_use.heading: How to use
tab_use.content_html: Put a few drops on your fingertips and massage about 3 drops into each area of your scalp: front, back, left, right and crown. Rub any oil left on your hands through the lengths. Use once a day. Do a patch test 24 hours before first use.

h.heading: Great hair starts at the scalp, not the ends

t.text_html: Stress, heat styling, tight hairstyles and harsh shampoos leave the scalp dry and irritated. Hair that grows from a stressed scalp is more likely to break, so it never looks as full as it could.

p1.heading: Feeds the roots
p1.text: Rosemary-infused plant oils go straight where hair grows, not just on the lengths.

p2.heading: Less breakage
p2.text: Stronger, better-conditioned strands mean less hair in your brush.

benefits.heading: What it does for your hair

b1.heading: Fuller-looking hair
b1.text: Helps reduce breakage so your hair keeps its length and looks thicker over time.

b2.heading: Calm, balanced scalp
b2.text: Soothes dryness, itch and flakes with a gentle, plant-based formula.

b3.heading: Fresh rosemary scent
b3.text: A clean, herbal scent that keeps your hair and scalp smelling fresh.

b4.heading: For every hair type
b4.text: Straight, wavy, curly, coily, color-treated. Women and men.

ingredients.heading: Three plant oils, nothing you don't need
ingredients.text_html: Rosemary is soaked in natural coconut and olive oil to draw out its goodness. No hormones, no drugs.

g1.label: Rosmarinus officinalis
g1.heading: Rosemary
g1.text: A classic hair-care botanical that refreshes the scalp and gives the oil its clean, herbal scent.

g2.label: Cocos nucifera
g2.heading: Coconut oil
g2.text: A nourishing plant oil that conditions strands and helps reduce breakage.

g3.label: Olea europaea
g3.heading: Olive oil
g3.text: A rich, gentle oil that softens hair and helps keep the scalp from drying out.

s1.heading: Apply
s1.text: Put a few drops on your fingertips. Split your scalp into 5 areas: front, back, left, right and crown.

s2.heading: Massage
s2.text: Massage about 3 drops into each area with your fingertips, using a gentle combing and pressing motion.

s3.heading: Repeat daily
s3.text: Rub any oil left on your hands through the lengths. Use once a day and keep going. Consistency is everything.

timeline.heading: Your first 90 days
timeline.footnote: Hair grows in cycles, so give it at least 8 to 12 weeks of daily use. Individual results vary.

t1.label: Week 1–2

t1.text: Less dryness and itch. Your scalp feels clean, calm and refreshed.

t2.label: Week 4–6
t2.heading: Stronger strands
t2.text: Hair feels softer and more conditioned, with less breakage when you brush.

t3.label: Week 8–12
t3.heading: Fuller-looking hair
t3.text: With daily use, hair looks thicker and healthier from root to tip.

faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.text_html: Still wondering? Email us and a real person will reply within 24 hours.

q1.question: How long until I see results?
q1.answer_html: Most people notice a calmer, more comfortable scalp within the first two weeks. Hair grows slowly and in cycles, so give it 8 to 12 weeks of daily use to judge the look of your hair. Individual results vary.

q2.question: Will it make my hair oily?
q2.answer_html: Use a few drops on the scalp only, not the lengths. If your hair gets oily easily, apply it in the evening and wash your hair the next morning.

q3.question: Can I use it on color-treated or curly hair?
q3.answer_html: Yes. It works on all hair types and textures, including color-treated, relaxed and natural hair.

q4.question: How long does one bottle last?
q4.answer_html: Each bottle holds 50 mL. With daily use it lasts about 1 to 2 months, depending on how much you use. That's why most customers pick the 2 or 3 bottle routine.

q5.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
q5.answer_html: It's made for daily use, but everyone's skin is different. Do a patch test behind your ear 24 hours before first use. Stop using it if irritation occurs. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding or under medical care, check with your doctor first.

q6.question: How long does shipping take?
q6.answer_html: Orders are processed within 1 to 3 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

q7.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
q7.answer_html: You're covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. Email us within 30 days of delivery and we'll refund you, even if the bottle is empty.

cta.heading: Love your hair in 30 days or your money back
cta.text_html: Use it every day for a month. If you're not happy, email us and we'll refund you. Even if the bottle is empty.
